startup.method: Local offline HTML, fresh isolated browser profile then reload. Hardware WebGPU, same host; OS/driver caches were not cleared. Preview is camera-only until compilation and warmup finish. No claimed full-start speedup.

inputChecks: Toybox builds no hidden item buttons at startup
All fourteen tools right-grab and release a GPU barrel without firing alternate actions
A quick released click cannot attach a late GPU picking result
Y preserves pistol alternate aim and releases cleanly
Weapon/ammo stays beside the reticle and equip hints disappear after 3.5 seconds
Center ammo readout reports manual reload then restores the unlimited supply
Menu uses readable body text and GPU glyphs render at device-pixel density

research.finding: Per-object compileAsync and progress callback support staged precompilation. Reviewed as an architectural example, not benchmarked.
Worker rendering demo separates canvas initialization, mesh import and readiness notification. Reviewed source; no code copied and no cross-engine speed claim.

proof.note: Silent Firefox boot recording. Screenshot durations retain elapsed wall time; profiling is a separate run.
